correctness.rationale: For each linearly admissible length-k factor, the required edge degrees give unit deficit sources D and sinks S. Every D-to-S path costs at least the position of the first 10 in the source (or n-1 if absent). The explicit injective route 0^a1^b s -> s1^b0^a realizes exactly those lower bounds and is a bijection by reversal cardinality. Strong connectedness plus Eulerian balance constructs an optimum, while the exceptional path requires an added edge containing 010. Four-state transfer-matrix enumeration proves the rational generating function. The standalone verifier constructed exact covering cycles for k=3..13 and independently optimized source-to-sink assignments for k=3..10; no infinite inference relies on those finite tests.

value.rationale: This completes the third symmetry orbit of binary forbidden-triple languages for the natural shortest cyclic covering problem: the palindrome orbit {010,101}. The exact all-length rational overhead law and computable optimum construction determine a nontrivial coverage invariant, and the forced use of the forbidden factor contrasts structurally with the previously studied no-triple-one case. The natural invariant has direct meaning as the minimal periodic window-test length. The result is not an arbitrary finite slice or a routine numerical extension.
